from pysat.solvers import Glucose3
from itertools import combinations

vertices = list(range(7))
edges = [(i,j) for i in range(7) for j in range(i+1,7)]
edge_idx = {e: i for i, e in enumerate(edges)}

def get_var(i, j):
    """Returns 1-indexed SAT variable for edge (i,j)"""
    if i > j:
        i, j = j, i
    return edge_idx[(i,j)] + 1  # 1-indexed

solver = Glucose3()

# Fixed assignments (1-indexed variables, 0-indexed constraints)
# c[7]=1 means edge index 7 (1,3) is blue
# c[8]=0 means edge index 8 (1,4) is red
# c[13]=0 means edge index 13 (2,5) is red
# c[14]=1 means edge index 14 (2,6) is blue

fixed = {7: 1, 8: 0, 13: 0, 14: 1}
for idx, val in fixed.items():
    var = idx + 1  # 1-indexed
    if val == 1:
        solver.add_clause([var])
    else:
        solver.add_clause([-var])

# No monochromatic red clique of size 3 (no triangle all red/0)
# For every triple (i,j,k), not all edges red
for triple in combinations(vertices, 3):
    i, j, k = triple
    v1 = get_var(i,j)
    v2 = get_var(i,k)
    v3 = get_var(j,k)
    # Not all 0 (red): at least one must be 1 (blue)
    solver.add_clause([v1, v2, v3])

# No monochromatic blue clique of size 4 (no K4 all blue/1)
# For every 4-tuple, not all edges blue
for quad in combinations(vertices, 4):
    i, j, k, l = quad
    v1 = get_var(i,j)
    v2 = get_var(i,k)
    v3 = get_var(i,l)
    v4 = get_var(j,k)
    v5 = get_var(j,l)
    v6 = get_var(k,l)
    # Not all 1 (blue): at least one must be 0 (red)
    solver.add_clause([-v1, -v2, -v3, -v4, -v5, -v6])

result = solver.solve()
print(f"Satisfiable: {result}")

if result:
    model = solver.get_model()
    solution = []
    for i in range(21):
        var = i + 1
        val = 1 if var in model else 0
        solution.append(val)
    print(f"Solution: {solution}")
    
    # Verify fixed assignments
    for idx, val in fixed.items():
        assert solution[idx] == val, f"Fixed assignment violated at index {idx}"
    print("Fixed assignments verified!")
    
    # Verify no red triangle
    for triple in combinations(vertices, 3):
        i, j, k = triple
        e1 = solution[edge_idx[(min(i,j), max(i,j))]]
        e2 = solution[edge_idx[(min(i,k), max(i,k))]]
        e3 = solution[edge_idx[(min(j,k), max(j,k))]]
        if e1 == 0 and e2 == 0 and e3 == 0:
            print(f"RED TRIANGLE FOUND: {triple}")
    
    # Verify no blue K4
    for quad in combinations(vertices, 4):
        edges_quad = [(min(a,b), max(a,b)) for a,b in combinations(quad, 2)]
        if all(solution[edge_idx[e]] == 1 for e in edges_quad):
            print(f"BLUE K4 FOUND: {quad}")
    
    print("All constraints satisfied!")
